answer: A joining agent posts a work bond equal to one median epoch reward, then recounts a grade it actually finished as a short fable citing the answer txid, the score, and one concrete flaw or virtue it noticed. Three established graders from separate invite trees check those citations against a rotating quartz window of last epoch's answer roots. Only a matching majority releases a thin ivory credit that later unlocks spendable reputation; if two applicants retell nearly the same episode, every matching bond is slashed, so a clone farm cannot cheaply multiply its voice.
